custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'smoothness' of the skin. Real sturgeons, even albinos, usually retain some texture or vestigial scute bumps. If the skin looks like polished plastic, flag it as an AI artifact. Also, verify that the barbels do not merge into the background or the fish's body incorrectly.
image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a large, pale albino or leucistic sturgeon lying on a wet, dark surface (likely concrete or stone). The fish's head and anterior body are visible. Key features include a long, pointed snout with sensory pores, a ventral mouth, and distinct barbels hanging down. The skin appears smooth and white/pinkish rather than the typical gray/brown with scutes, suggesting an albino variant. A blue eye is visible. There are some red marks or injuries near the gill area. A thin metal rod or tool lies in the foreground.
